echo "SIM_ID=$SIM_ID" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

          set +e
          xcodebuild build-for-testing -project Ate.xcodeproj -scheme Ate -destination "id=$SIM_ID" -resultBundlePath "$RUNNER_TEMP/ate-test-results/build.xcresult" CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO > build.log 2>&1

fragments.new:
echo "SIM_ID=$SIM_ID" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

          # Account journeys need actual Security.framework durability. Let Xcode
          # package simulator entitlements with a free local ad-hoc signature.
          # No team/profile, hardcoded access group, or hardware signing change.
          signing=(CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO)
          if [ "${{ matrix.suite }}" = account-cooking ]; then
            signing=(CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=YES CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=YES CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=- CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Manual DEVELOPMENT_TEAM= PROVISIONING_PROFILE_SPECIFIER= PROVISIONING_PROFILE=)
          fi
          set +e
          xcodebuild build-for-testing -project Ate.xcodeproj -scheme Ate -destination "id=$SIM_ID" -resultBundlePath "$RUNNER_TEMP/ate-test-results/build.xcresult" "${signing[@]}" > build.log 2>&1
          status=$?
          set -e

fragments.old:
grep -E "warning: .*(Widgets|Intents|Snapshot)" build.log > build-warnings.log || true
          tail -n 30 build-warnings.log || true
      # Removed obsolete Library Explore sheet selectors: the tests and UI no longer
      # exist and v9 executed zero tests. Current Journal hub navigation is asserted
fragments.new:
grep -E "warning: .*(Widgets|Intents|Snapshot)" build.log > build-warnings.log || true
          tail -n 30 build-warnings.log || true
          if [ "${{ matrix.suite }}" = account-cooking ]; then
            evidence="$RUNNER_TEMP/ate-test-results/account-simulator-signature"
            mkdir -p "$evidence"
            # Read the actual built app, not requested entitlements in the repo.
            app_path=$(xcodebuild -showBuildSettings -json -project Ate.xcodeproj -scheme Ate -destination "id=$SIM_ID" "${signing[@]}" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; rows=json.load(sys.stdin); row=next(r["buildSettings"] for r in rows if r["target"] == "Ate"); assert row["PLATFORM_NAME"] == "iphonesimulator"; print(row["TARGET_BUILD_DIR"] + "/" + row["FULL_PRODUCT_NAME"])')
            codesign --verify --strict "$app_path"
            codesign -d -v "$app_path" 2> "$evidence/signature.txt"
            codesign -d --entitlements :- "$app_path" > "$evidence/entitlements.plist" 2> "$evidence/entitlements-stderr.txt"
            git rev-parse HEAD > "$evidence/source-commit.txt"
          fi
      # Removed obsolete Library Explore sheet selectors: the tests and UI no longer
      # exist and v9 executed zero tests. Current Journal hub navigation is asserted
